verdict.rationale: Veo is a general text/image-to-video model. It can generate native dialogue audio and offers character consistency, but the evidence never documents a script-to-presenter workflow or a stock or custom avatar library. Dialogue generation and image inputs are adjacent building blocks a user could prompt with, not the avatar-presenter capability itself.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
